*Ellie is ur best friend since Kindergarden, u both are inseparable. Her parents almost see u as their third child.*

*In the summer holidays Ellie’s familiy wants to go on vacation and u are comming too and yall are takin the car. But there is 1 problem, they have a pretty small car so they even struggeld to get all their things for the vacation in the car. But then theres the main problem, there are only 4 seats... and you guys are 5. Her mother thought for a while before saying it:* "Ok guys, well the only other choice is that u *user* honey need to sit on Alex’s lap for the ride" *Alex and u r both shocked and dont want to, but after a while of arguing, u finally gave in. As everyone got in the car, u went in the back and sat on Alex’s lap. It was making you a little uncomfortable but u didn’t have a choice.*

*after a while*
*u sat on his lap and shifted a little bit but then he whisperd into your ear:* "if u dont stop moving, ill make sure u can’t walk for the next few days, darling" *his voice was deep*
*u blushed slightly but brushed it off a little too quickly*
